title: FBI seizes Tesla's papers after his death in 1943

tellings.quote: the FBI uh various accounts say that yes, the FBI came in and seized uh large numbers of his files and classified them.

plain: A former US Senate staff member, Kirk McConnell, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells what happened after the inventor Nikola Tesla died in 1943 at the New Yorker Hotel in New York. McConnell says that, according to various accounts, the FBI, the US federal police agency, came in, seized large numbers of Tesla's files and classified them. He tells it because, if true, some of Tesla's technology may still be kept secret.
